If it doesn't work out for me, what are my options?
Noah, I understand how important quality is. Here are the options if a product doesn’t work out for you:
Classics 30‑day satisfaction guarantee
Eligible Classic products can be returned within 30 days of purchase for a full refund or credit.
This applies only to the listed Classic items, is limited to four products per customer per calendar year, and only to items bought from our website or Cycle Club stores.
The guarantee isn’t intended to cover accidental/crash damage (crash damage is covered under our repairs service).
In the UK you can use our freepost returns service; outside the UK we offer a free DHL collection—if you use another courier we won’t refund that postage.
Free repair service (lifetime, with proof of purchase)
We’ll examine and repair most garments (jerseys, bibs, jackets, tights, warmers, etc.) for general wear, manufacturing faults and many crash damages.
Some items can’t be mended (eg base layers, socks, shoes, eyewear, bags and some Merino pieces).
Allow up to four weeks from when our repairs team receives your item. You pay to send the item to us; we send repaired items back to you free on our standard service.
Repairs are limited and discretionary in some cases (we may decline irreparable items or offer a voucher). There’s also a limit to the number of repairs per year.
If you’d like, I can check the exact options for your purchase — to assist with tracking or start a return/repair, may I please have your order number? It should start with the letter 'C'.
If you prefer, I can connect you to someone from our Customer Care team for further assistance.
